scope: New human criterion interpretation and read-only PAS resource evidence audit; no model execution, new scoring, old checkpoint hashing, or changes to prior decisions.

human_instruction.text: 不用五领域都最强，总的稍微高一点就行。因为我们有很显著优势内存小得多
human_instruction.source: Direct human clarification relayed by parent /root in this turn
human_instruction.timing: After paired results; explicitly a human objective revision, not a preregistered success under the old rule
human_instruction.criterion: Aggregate answer F1 slightly above the strongest comparable baseline, together with substantial endpoint memory advantage; per-domain tradeoffs must remain visible.

decision.reason: The revised objective removes the per-domain rejection rule. The fixed dynamic graph has an exploratory aggregate improvement over the historical wide-QV anchor and independently measured memory savings against original formal PAS. This justifies a candidate, not a claim of strongest-baseline quality superiority.

quality.exploratory_primary_metric: Five-domain equal-weight macro answer F1 on the fixed 100 already explored DEV questions
interpretation: Historical wide-QV is an exploratory anchor, not the strongest baseline.
The small dynamic-static difference is a point estimate on a single explored set; no significance, equivalence, or general dynamic necessity is established.
Formal PAS quality and this FIT-only DEV quality differ in training/evaluation conditions. Formal PAS cannot be defeated by comparing these scalars directly.
Before the next quality comparison, freeze the aggregate and its weights. Formal AP19 and equal-domain macro are distinct; do not select the favorable aggregate after results.
Medical and finance tradeoffs remain reported, but are no longer hard rejection conditions.

limits: Actual original PAS implementation retains its mixed dtypes, mandatory masks, CPU training-history objects and tiny GPU statistics. This is not an equal-dtype, optimally folded PAS comparison.
Five fixed fresh 32-token windows demonstrate these measured allocated peaks, not the worst peak over all inputs, latency, energy, or total host memory.
This resource-only pass does not improve or newly validate PAS F1, and use of its formal checkpoint for resources is not permission to use it as a FIT-only teacher or quality-selection control.

PAS preparation mistakenly hashed an overbroad historical source map once; the preserved preactivation record reports 12.935504918918014 seconds, no QA parsing, quality consumption or model requests. This is cost, not scientific progress.

minimum_next_evidence.question: Does the response module add aggregate utility under the actual common recipe?
minimum_next_evidence.control: Matched QV-only: same base, wide-QV coordinates/initialization, original 1213 FIT and 87 updates, GPU optimizer and fold, input/generation conditions; the old historical wide row is not this control.
minimum_next_evidence.action: Freeze this control and the candidate without beta/rank/LR/step searching. It tests module net utility; it need not beat each domain.

minimum_next_evidence.question: Is the fixed candidate competitive with a strong legal FIT-only reference on the same aggregate and data?
minimum_next_evidence.control: A complete comparable FIT-only strong-reference quality result; existing formal PAS resource CP is not a legal FIT-only quality arm. Use the strongest completed comparable reference, not historical QV by label.
minimum_next_evidence.action: The matched-QV and strong-FIT controls can be preregistered as one comparative batch; no scientific requirement to inspect the first and tune before the second.

minimum_next_evidence.question: Does the frozen method slightly exceed the strongest baseline on the paper evaluation while retaining endpoint advantages?
minimum_next_evidence.control: Full formal 1% training/evaluation with the locked aggregate, task protocol and strongest completed formal baselines; final actual complete graph, complete bytes, and same-card resource windows.
minimum_next_evidence.action: Formal testing follows a frozen candidate decision; no TEST-based architecture or parameter selection. Report all domains even though the aggregate is the quality decision.

not_required: No requirement to exceed every domain independently.
No new beta-scale, rank, learning-rate, or step sweep is implied.
No precision study or automatic reopening of prior compression branches is implied.

authorship_and_limits.disclosure: Author of paired_verify.py and earlier paired scientific reviews; independent reader of the new PAS resource result.
authorship_and_limits.executed: Only local JSON reading, small-file hashes and arithmetic on already verified scalar resource measurements; no new F1 calculation.
authorship_and_limits.admission: This review is a scientific candidate-retention judgment, not authorization of a particular new worker or budget.
